facts.fact: The UNECA/IDRC snapshot, from a questionnaire the Ministry of Health completed in January 2019, says the Ministry of Health is responsible for birth and death registration, with its Bureau of Vital Statistics compiling the statistics.
facts.system: birth and death registration system under the Ministry of Health

facts.fact: The snapshot says Liberia had a CRVS improvement plan in force, the Investment Case 2016-2020 (a revision of the Birth Registration Improvement Plan 2014-2018), costed at US$3 million over five years, with improving civil registration information systems among its main areas.
facts.system: birth and death registration system under the Ministry of Health

facts.fact: The snapshot reports a Global Financing Facility grant of US$1 million for birth and death registration, including an integrated civil registration management information system, and over US$200,000 from UNICEF in 2015-2018; the government allocation for the year was not available and the expected government allocation to the listed priority activities was nil.
facts.system: birth and death registration system under the Ministry of Health

facts.fact: The snapshot, on the Ministry of Health's January 2019 questionnaire, says civil registration offices prepare legal and statistical paper records in a combined form.
facts.system: birth and death registration system under the Ministry of Health

facts.fact: The snapshot says mobile technology had recently been introduced at the central level to register births and pay by mobile money, on an online platform at www.liberiabirthcertificate.com, and was expected to be used for deaths.

The snapshot says online registration ran at the central level only in January 2019 and was to be cascaded to all parts of the country by the end of 2019; there were 15 birth and death registration centres, one in an urban district of each county, across 92 health districts, with registration reactivated in four Monrovia hospitals. Its table of where computers are used names the County Service Centers but its yes/no marks cannot be read in the text.
